name: UI Garage
summary: UI pattern gallery where designers could search interface and experience examples; now closing down.
description: A website that collected and shared UI design patterns so designers could search for specific interfaces and experiences. Its only readable page is a shutdown notice: the site has not been updated for a while, the founder no longer sees a reason to continue it, and he has moved on to another project.
contains: shutdown notice: site closing after 8 years
was #1 product of the day on Product Hunt
